name: Huatai Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: Huatai Securities Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides securities and financial services for individual, enterprise, and institutional clients in Mainland China and internationally. It operates through Wealth Management, Institutional Services, Investment Management, International Business, and Other segments.
